name: Multipify Connect for WooCommerce
author: multipify

sections.description:
Multipify Connect for WooCommerce connects your WordPress / WooCommerce store to the Multipify ecommerce platform through Multipify’s secure connection system. No manual WooCommerce Consumer Key or Consumer Secret setup is required for the current connection flow.

Multipify is designed to help merchants manage, translate and expand an ecommerce business from one platform. Features available to a store depend on the merchant’s Multipify plan, enabled modules, country and connected third-party services.

Multilingual WooCommerce

Use Multipify to create and manage translations for supported WooCommerce and WordPress content, including products, product descriptions, categories, attributes, pages, posts, menus and supported storefront text.

  • Choose a reference/source language and one or more target languages.
  • Support regional language variants such as English (United States), English (United Kingdom), English (Australia), Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Mexico), Portuguese (Brazil) and other supported locales.
  • Automatically translate supported new or updated content when automatic translation is enabled.
  • Reuse stored translations to avoid translating unchanged content again.
  • Keep previously saved translations when automatic translation is no longer active.
  • Configure a storefront language selector with language, country, flag and currency display options.
  • Customize selector colors and presentation from Multipify.
  • Preserve protected technical values such as identifiers and URLs where applicable.

Product and catalog workflows

Multipify can centralize supported product workflows for connected stores and sales channels. Depending on the enabled Multipify modules, merchants can work with product information, descriptions, images, categories, attributes and publication/mapping workflows from their Multipify account.

Multipify also provides product-import workflows for supported sources, including URL-based product import and supported supplier/source integrations. AI-assisted tools can be used to improve supported product content and images before publication.

Marketplaces and sales channels

Multipify provides multi-channel tools for supported marketplace and ecommerce connections. Availability, permissions and supported operations vary by marketplace, seller account, country and Multipify plan.

Supported or integrated channel workflows in the Multipify ecosystem may include:

  • Amazon
  • eBay
  • Etsy
  • Walmart
  • Cdiscount / Octopia
  • Kaufland
  • Allegro
  • ManoMano
  • Back Market
  • Zalando
  • Fnac
  • Darty
  • Carrefour
  • Decathlon
  • Leroy Merlin
  • Maisons du Monde
  • Galeries Lafayette
  • La Redoute
  • H&M
  • Macy’s
  • Nordstrom
  • E.Leclerc
  • La Poste
  • Showroomprive
  • Conforama
  • Boulanger
  • ePRICE
  • Bricomarche
  • TikTok Shop
  • SHEIN
  • Temu
  • Newegg
  • Best Buy
  • bol
  • OTTO

Multipify can also work with supported ecommerce store connections such as WooCommerce / WordPress, Shopify, Wix and PrestaShop. A marketplace or platform name in this list does not imply endorsement by, partnership with, or ownership by Multipify. Connection availability can change and some channels require a separate seller account or approval from the third-party platform.

AI ecommerce tools

Depending on the Multipify services enabled for the account, the platform can provide AI-assisted ecommerce workflows such as:

  • AI-assisted product descriptions and content.
  • AI-assisted product image workflows.
  • AI video workflows using supported third-party video services.
  • AI-assisted customer messaging.
  • AI Store Builder workflows for supported WordPress / WooCommerce and Shopify projects.
  • Storefront generation from supported catalog/product data.

Orders, operations and business tools

Multipify includes additional ecommerce management modules that can be used with supported connections and plans, including:

  • Centralized order and product workflows.
  • Automated or assisted invoicing workflows.
  • Newsletter creation and sending.
  • Professional email connections using supported providers and SMTP configurations.
  • Digital-product delivery workflows.
  • Supported shipping and label workflows, including carrier integrations where available.
  • Customer and business messaging tools.
  • Multipify Agent Marketplace workflows.

Some functions are provided by the Multipify web application rather than executed entirely inside this WordPress plugin. This plugin acts as the WordPress / WooCommerce connector and provides the WordPress-side functionality required by supported Multipify features.

Secure connection

The current connector uses a Multipify secure token/pairing connection instead of asking the merchant to manually create and copy WooCommerce Consumer Keys and Consumer Secrets.

The plugin exposes authenticated Multipify REST endpoints for supported operations. Requests must pass the connector’s authentication checks before protected operations can run.

WooCommerce compatibility

Multipify Connect declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) where applicable and is designed for current WordPress / WooCommerce installations matching the requirements shown above.

External services

This plugin connects to Multipify, an external ecommerce service operated through https://multipify.eu/.

When a store owner connects a site or enables Multipify features, information required for those requested features may be exchanged between the WordPress site and Multipify. Depending on the feature, this can include store configuration, supported catalog/product data, translation content, pages, categories, attributes, order-related data needed by enabled workflows, and AI Store configuration. Multipify may in turn communicate with third-party services explicitly configured or used by the merchant for marketplace, AI, email, shipping, payment or other ecommerce workflows.

The exact data exchanged depends on the features the merchant chooses to enable. Review Multipify’s terms and privacy information before connecting a production store.

Privacy

The plugin is intended to transmit only data required for the Multipify features enabled by the store owner. Authentication credentials and pairing tokens should be treated as confidential. Store owners can disconnect Multipify and revoke access according to the connection controls available in WordPress and Multipify.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Multipify Connect for WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate WooCommerce when you want to use WooCommerce store features.
  3. Make sure your WordPress site uses HTTPS.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Multipify (or the Multipify connection screen shown by the plugin).
  5. Start the secure Multipify connection process and follow the on-screen instructions.
  6. Open your Multipify account and select the connected WordPress / WooCommerce store.
  7. Configure the Multipify features you want to use, such as translation languages, automatic translation, language/country/currency selector and supported ecommerce/channel workflows.

The current connection flow does not require merchants to manually generate or copy a WooCommerce Consumer Key and Consumer Secret.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create WooCommerce REST API keys manually?

No. The current Multipify connector uses the plugin’s secure Multipify connection/pairing flow. The old instructions asking users to generate and copy a Consumer Key and Consumer Secret are no longer the normal connection procedure.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

WooCommerce is required for WooCommerce-specific store functionality. The plugin also contains Multipify provisioning/connection components used by supported Multipify WordPress workflows.

Can Multipify translate my WooCommerce store?

Yes, when store translation is enabled for the connected account. Multipify can manage supported product and WordPress content translations and can automatically process supported new or changed content according to the store’s translation settings and plan.

Can I use regional languages such as en-US, en-GB, en-AU, es-ES or es-MX?

Yes. Multipify’s translation system can distinguish supported regional locales so merchants can configure language variants independently when available.

Can I customize the language selector?

Yes. Current Multipify translation settings can control selector presentation, including combinations of language, country, flag and currency information, as well as supported appearance/color options.

Does Multipify connect to marketplaces?

Multipify provides multi-channel workflows for supported marketplaces and ecommerce platforms. Availability and the operations supported for each channel depend on the merchant account, marketplace API permissions, country, Multipify plan and current integration status. See the Marketplaces and sales channels section above for the channel ecosystem covered by Multipify.

Are all Multipify features included for free?

No. Available features depend on the Multipify account, plan, credits, enabled modules and third-party services. Some external providers can also charge their own fees.

What happens to existing translations if automatic translation is stopped?

Translations already saved to supported store content are intended to remain available. Stopping automatic translation prevents new automatic translation activity according to the account’s current entitlement; it is not intended to erase previously saved translations.

Is HPOS supported?

The plugin declares WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage compatibility where applicable.

Does Multipify replace my marketplace seller accounts?

No. Third-party marketplaces generally require their own merchant/seller accounts, permissions and approval processes. Multipify connects supported workflows to those services; it does not replace their account requirements.
sections.changelog:
5.18.0

  • Updated the connector documentation for the current secure Multipify token/pairing connection flow.
  • Removed obsolete documentation requiring manual WooCommerce Consumer Key and Consumer Secret setup.
  • Added multilingual WooCommerce translation capabilities and regional locale support documentation.
  • Added customizable language/country/flag/currency selector documentation.
  • Added current Multipify ecommerce, AI, store-builder and multi-channel feature documentation.
  • Added marketplace/channel information and clearer third-party service disclosures.
  • Improved WordPress.org plugin-page description, installation instructions and FAQ.

5.17.0

  • Improved the storefront language selector and regional flag handling.

5.16.0

  • Improved translation and storefront integration workflows.

1.1.0

  • Added Multipify AI Store provisioning components.
  • Added secure per-store pairing for automated provisioning.
  • Added authenticated Multipify REST endpoints for supported provisioning operations.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
